`mcanouil` is a Quarto extension with three formats: `mcanouil-typst` for PDF, `mcanouil-html` and `mcanouil-revealjs`.
One preset gives the colours, fonts, style and motif of all three formats.
The extension has six document types, from a full report to an invoice.
The targets are WCAG 2.2 AA in HTML and Reveal.js, and PDF/UA-1 in PDF.

[See a report rendered by this site](preview.pdf).

![](preview.pdf){.embed-art loading="lazy" title="A report rendered by mcanouil-typst"}

## Installation

```bash
quarto add {{< var extension.reference >}}
```

This command installs the extension in the `_extensions` directory.
If you use version control, commit this directory.

::: {.btn-group role="group" aria-label="Quarto Wizard installer options"}

[Visual Studio Code](vscode://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Visual Studio Code using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[Positron](positron://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in Positron using the Quarto Wizard extension."}
[VSCodium](vscodium://mcanouil.quarto-wizard/install?repo={{< var extension.wizard-reference >}}){.btn .btn-outline-primary title="Install {{< var extension.reference >}} in VSCodium using the Quarto Wizard extension."}

:::

The extension needs Quarto 1.12.1 or later.
To check the PDF tags, install veraPDF with `quarto install verapdf`.

## Quick start

Render one document to the three formats:

```yaml
title: "My report"
format:
  mcanouil-typst: default
  mcanouil-html: default
  mcanouil-revealjs: default
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
```

Select a document type:

```yaml
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    type: report
    layout: full
```

| Type | Formats | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report` | Typst, HTML | Compact report, or full report with a cover and chapter dividers. Also Quarto books. |
| `article` | Typst, HTML | One column with margin notes and a CRediT table. |
| `memo` | Typst, HTML | Note, minutes, agenda or brief, with a banner. |
| `letter` | Typst | Letter with an address window, NF Z 11-001 or DIN 5008. |
| `invoice` | Typst | Invoice with calculated totals. |
| `workshop` | Typst, HTML, Reveal.js | Session handout, page and deck with exercises and solutions. |

: The six document types. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[16,24,60]"}

A document without a type in `mcanouil-revealjs` is a presentation deck.

::: {.callout-important}

The extension embeds its tools, for example code-window, gitlink and veil.
Do not list them again in your own `filters:`.
See [Embedded tools](reference.qmd#embedded-tools).

:::

## Version 1.0

Version 1.0 is a new extension.
The options, components and document types of the 0.x versions do not exist in 1.0, and there is no migration path.
The [Changelog](changelog.qmd) lists the earlier versions.
